exposure: antenatal detection of intra-abdominal cystic lesion
outcome: diagnosis of left torsed ovarian cyst compressing ileocecal junction
cohort: A single neonate who was detected antenatally to have a cystic lesion per abdomen and presented with features of intestinal obstruction on the first postnatal day.
finding: A neonate presenting with features of intestinal obstruction due to a left torsed ovarian cyst, detected antenatally, was successfully treated with emergency exploratory laparotomy and left oophorectomy.
